newsitem.title: KENYA: Phone lines down in Nairobi for three hours.
newsitem.headline: Phone lines down in Nairobi for three hours.

text.p: Telephone lines were down for up to three hours in most of Nairobi's commercial district on Monday and the Kenya Posts & Telecommunications Corp (KPTC) offered no explanation, subscribers said.
It was the second such failure in a month. KPTC officials were unavailable to comment.
Residents of the capital are already experiencing lengthy power shortages after Kenya Power & Lighting Co closed one of its major generating plants for maintenance early this month.
The Nairobi Stock Exchange said trading was not seriously affected by the telephone outage.
